_why: Commits and digests this package legitimately DISCUSSES but was not produced from. head-consistency.py refuses any other SHA in a claim-bearing member, so a stale head from a superseded round cannot appear silently. Every entry here is a deliberate mention with its reason. The head, the parent and the commits between them are not listed: they are what this package IS, and they are derived rather than named. TWO ENTRIES HERE ARE DESCRIBED AS SET-ASIDE COHORTS, and both belong to the PREVIOUS lane rather than to this one: V15 declared that it set no cohort aside while two of its own green batteries had their figures declined, which is the definition of the word, and this lane classifies them correctly rather than repeating the declaration. This lane itself sets no cohort aside.

commits.67247ecc39a6e5f6224c64ca3ab1af163ee023b1: The V15 independent review this lane answers, on review/catena-wave-1-e1-corrections-v15-independent. It answered SEMANTIC CHANGES REQUIRED on transport and final authority, EVIDENCE CHANGES REQUIRED on the package, and CHANGES REQUIRED overall, at the exact parent. Every lane from V5 to V12, and V15, could name the review it answers by commit; V14 could not, and the unpublished V13 review stays the one gap in the chain and is V13's alone.
commits.db5f651e4eb2d10a15d1a594a4286ac7048f612c: The V15 evidence commit on evidence/catena-e1-corrections-v15-handoff, carrying the immutable handoff of the head this lane corrects. Named so the chain from the reviewed package to this correction is followable without the reviewer reconstructing it.
commits.2778285849f2973ea89d1cfd5b2751ed4ae58e54: Current origin/main at the time of this lane, recorded so a reviewer can see this candidate is not integrated with it and does not overlap it on any Catena path.
commits.0d11766ec232b2b4e46a7d1b0ada56ef22370004: The V14 independent review, on review/catena-wave-1-e1-corrections-v14-independent. Named where this lane states which review each of the preserved closures was passed by, so a reviewer can tell V14-inherited closure from V15 closure from V16 work. Not the review this lane answers.
commits.711b598ab43543113ccb924234fc8ef4ddb76370: Not a commit: the V15 package's ZIP SHA-256, at 1,400,092 bytes over 69 members, quoted so the artifact this lane supersedes is identified by its bytes rather than by its name alone.
commits.733e84909e0e8049629187352d3800be320e469d: Not a commit: the SHA-256 of src/web/browser/catena/catena.css, byte-identical at both endpoints, quoted where this package claims no stylesheet changed.
commits.7779d1f19ca175fd315cd7164f5347cc3c08d68b: Not a commit: the SHA-256 of src/web/browser/catena/index.html, byte-identical at both endpoints, quoted where this package claims no markup changed.
commits.64683c0b8bb9624278cb136e8e8cbcbd4875bff5: Not a commit: the SHA-256 of the FIRST attempt ledger the PREVIOUS lane retired, 2,501 bytes over five rows. Quoted because this lane's complete predecessor history counts the package attempts recorded across all three V15 ledgers rather than the six the shipped one carries, and a reviewer handed that file must be able to tell whether it is the one being counted. It carries a battery that reached no terminal row at all.
commits.5b0c380cf7fab7b507dfedd6bdc0a6ade71cea38: Not a commit: the SHA-256 of the SECOND attempt ledger the PREVIOUS lane retired, 45,619 bytes over eighty rows. Quoted for the same reason. It carried two batteries whose figures were declined -- SET-ASIDE COHORTS of the V15 lane, which V15's own PROVENANCE.md declared did not exist -- and five package attempts, four discarded and one that reached a sealed terminal row before its own anti-backdating audit refused a package timestamp chosen an hour before the attempts it named.
commits.69f2575421ba976271c936b1abd4b39dbe8b98fd: The V14 head, which is the parent of the V15 head this lane corrects and therefore the endpoint the V15 comparison was drawn against. Named where this record traces the chain of heads a figure was measured at, so a reviewer can tell which endpoint each inherited closure was passed at. Not an endpoint of this lane: V16's parent is b9202882 and its head is the commit this package was sealed for.
commits.45c491abf22351e14fe22648a5a05e47f6abd818: Not a commit: the SHA-256 the RELEASE BINDING records for src/web/browser/catena/index.html, which is one of the four stale bindings this lane leaves fail-closed and unsigned. Quoted beside the file's actual digest 7779d1f1... so a reviewer can see that the two differ, that the difference is the staleness itself, and that this lane re-signed nothing. The file is byte-identical at both endpoints; it is the BINDING that is out of date, and correcting it belongs to the release owner.
